extra.final_summary: The data had three issues affecting the question: 1) The island label 'dream' was lowercase and needed normalization to 'Dream'; 2) Three rows had negative flipper_length_mm values (-182, -210, -220) that were below the minimum allowed (170) and were excluded as likely data entry errors; 3) The 'sex' column had a trailing space in one value (' female'), but it was not relevant to the question. After fixing the label variant and excluding the invalid rows, the analysis shows 37 penguins were measured on Biscoe, 19 on Dream, and 10 on Torgersen.
